parsed.borrower: Novanta Corporation (Lead Borrower), with co-borrowers Novanta UK Investments Holding Limited, Novanta Europe GmbH and Novanta Inc. (Holdings)

covenants.name: Consolidated Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio as at the end of any Measurement Period to be greater than (i) 4.00 : 1.00, or (ii) 4.50 : 1.00 at the Borrowers’ option for the four (4) consecutive quarters following a Designated Acquisition;

covenants.name: Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
covenants.quote: for the Measurement Periods ending as of the last day of each of the four (4) consecutive fiscal quarters following the consummation of the Specified Acquisition, 1.00 : 1:00 and (y) thereafter, 1.25 : 1.00.

parsed.notes:
Both covenants are tested quarterly, starting with the Measurement Period ending September 26, 2025. The Third Amendment (June 8, 2026) restated both covenants; the amended text is quoted above.

Leverage covenant:
- The base maximum is 4.00x, previously 3.75x.
- At the Borrowers' election, the limit rises to 4.50x (previously 4.25x) for the four consecutive quarters after a Designated Acquisition, meaning a Permitted Acquisition with consideration of at least $50M.
- This holiday may be used no more than twice.
- Despite its name, the 'Consolidated Leverage Ratio' is a net ratio. It nets unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of Loan Parties, cash held with the Agent or Lenders or in the US, and cash pledged to the Secured Parties, capped at $100M.

Fixed charge coverage covenant:
- The minimum is 1.00x for the four fiscal quarters after the Specified Acquisition closes, then reverts to 1.25x.
- The Specified Acquisition is the equity purchase under the June 8, 2026 Equity Purchase Agreement with Runway Midco/Runway Buyer.
- The 1.00x step is tied to a closing that had not occurred as of the amendment date, so no calendar date is recorded for it.
- Numerator: EBITDA less cash capex less cash taxes.
- Denominator: cash interest, scheduled amortization (deemed paid even if prepaid), other scheduled debt payments, and Restricted Payments under 7.06(d).

The interest coverage slot in 7.10(a) is [Reserved].

Other Third Amendment changes:
- Deferred purchase price and non-contingent seller debt for the Specified Acquisition is excluded from Consolidated Funded Indebtedness unless unpaid 10 Business Days after it falls due.
- A new pricing level 5 applies above 3.75x leverage: SOFR+2.00% and Base Rate+1.00%.

Consolidated EBITDA add-backs:
- Acquisition expenses, capped at 15% of EBITDA.
- Unusual or non-recurring charges including restructuring, capped at 25%.
- Run-rate cost savings and synergies from Specified Transactions over a 12-month window, capped at 15%.
- Non-Cash Charges, which include impairments and write-downs, equity-method losses, purchase accounting, mark-to-market hedging losses, non-cash disposition losses and stock-based compensation. This category is uncapped.

The 2026 delayed draw term loans (Second Amendment, May 15, 2026) require pro forma compliance with Section 7.10 at each funding.

Pro forma compliance with 7.10 is also used as an incurrence test for:
- Permitted Acquisitions, where a Designated Acquisition is tested at 4.25x per the unamended text of 7.03(j);
- restricted payments under 7.06(h);
- other investments under 7.03(p);
- unsecured debt under 7.02(n).
These incurrence tests are not separate maintenance covenants.

Required Lenders alone can amend the financial covenants.

There is no unrestricted subsidiary concept; all subsidiaries are restricted.
parsed.facility: $850M revolving credit facility (including $50M L/C and $50M swing line sublimits); €65.31M Euro term loan; $75M USD term loan; 2026 delayed draw USD term loan commitments added May 15, 2026 (size per Schedule 2.01, not stated in the text; draw period up to 6 months); $350M incremental capacity. All facilities mature June 27, 2030.

terms.quote: no Loan Party may transfer legal title to, or otherwise dispose of, or license on an exclusive basis (excluding exclusive licenses limited by territory or field of use), any Material IP Rights to a Subsidiary that is not a Loan Party, if the primary purpose of such transfer or license is to incur new financing at such Subsidiary that is not a Loan Party and to cause a release of the Liens on the Collateral on such Material IP Rights, in each case as reasonably determined by the Lead Borrower.
terms.summary: There are no unrestricted subsidiaries. A 'Pluralsight Protection' bars Investments and Dispositions that transfer or exclusively license material IP to non-Loan Party subsidiaries. It applies only where the primary purpose is to raise new financing there and release the collateral liens, as determined by the borrower.

terms.quote: contractually subordinate the Liens of the Administrative Agent on all or substantially all of the Collateral to the Liens on the collateral securing any other indebtedness for borrowed money
terms.summary: Contractually subordinating the liens on all or substantially all collateral, or subordinating payment rights, to other borrowed-money debt requires consent of each directly and adversely affected Lender. The exception is where each such Lender was offered a bona fide pro rata opportunity to provide the senior debt on the same terms. DIP-type post-bankruptcy debt is excluded.

terms.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, no Domestic Subsidiary that becomes an Excluded Subsidiary pursuant to clause (b) of this definition shall be deemed to be an Excluded Subsidiary except as a result of a transaction permitted under this Agreement resulting in some of the Equity Interests of such Domestic Subsidiary becoming owned by an unaffiliated third party that is for a bona fide business purpose and not primarily for the purpose of releasing Collateral.
terms.summary: A domestic guarantor that stops being wholly owned becomes an Excluded Subsidiary, and is released, only if the equity went to an unaffiliated third party for a bona fide business purpose and not primarily to release collateral.

The agreement has no unrestricted subsidiary designation mechanism, so there is no cap on unrestricted subsidiaries. Investments in non-guarantor wholly-owned subsidiaries are limited to the greater of $75M and 5% of total assets, but other baskets also apply.

terms.quote: the aggregate amount of run-rate cost savings and synergies added pursuant to this clause (vi) for any such Measurement Period shall not exceed 15% of Consolidated EBITDA for such period (calculated after giving effect to any such add-back and all other permitted add-backs and adjustments)
terms.summary: Run-rate cost savings and synergies are capped at 15% of EBITDA. Unusual or non-recurring charges, including restructuring, are separately capped at 25%. Acquisition expenses are capped at 15%. Each cap is calculated after giving effect to the add-backs.
The agreement contains no equity cure right for the financial covenants.
